description: Comment “Marketing” and I’ll send you the full setup guide 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to run all of your marketing for you? I tried this and the results it generated were literally insane. Here’s how: 1. Go to ChatGPT → Plugins 2. Search “Higgsfield” → Install Plugin This unlocks a full marketing team directly inside ChatGPT. Prompt 1: Upload a photo of your product and say: “Using Higgsfield, build me a full marketing campaign for this product. I want product shots and a few video commercials I can put on my website.” ChatGPT and Higgsfield work together to give you insane marketing assets. Prompt 2: “Now take these and turn them into UGC ads I can actually run on Meta.” A minute later you get UGC creators holding your product and talking about it, without you ever having to film anything. Here’s the coolest part: Prompt 3: “Now build me a full 3D website for my product with scroll animations and everything.” Higgsfield generates a perfectly modern 3D website, the kind of stuff marketing agencies charge tens of thousands of dollars for. #HiggsfieldPartner #ChatGPT #AI #Marketing
